title: Existing production resources remain unchanged during command-service introduction
description:
As an operator, I want the portable command service introduced without modifying unrelated deployed resources, so that validation cannot disrupt existing production workloads.

Feature: Isolated command-service introduction
  Scenario: The portable command service is deployed for validation
    Given the current production resource inventory has been recorded
    When the new companion service is deployed under distinct names
    Then existing Amplify, scoring, and pipeline resources remain unchanged
    And no legacy compatibility behavior is added without evidence of an active consumer
    And activation requires an explicit future decision
